title: Armor HUD
description: This mod adds 3 key features, zoom, durability and coordinates.
body:
This mod adds 3 key features:

Durability overlay - Allows you to see your armour and hand held items durability and % it is on. 

Zoom - Allows you to zoom using C.

Coordinates display - Allows you to view your coordinates quick and efficently with a GUI.

Clicking r shift allows you to edit the position of the areas.
